jobs.title: Software Manager - HV Project Database
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Drive the development and enhancement of the PDB -Tool globally to meet User needs and align with company goals.
Overseeing the tool's architecture, coding adherence and roadmap, prioritizing development tasks.
Liaising with local PDB Users/Development Teams to ensure aligned development and extension of tool into additional product lines.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Drive Strategic Tool Development: Define and maintain the tool’s architecture and roadmap in alignment with Business Unit’s PDB Roadmap
Analysing detailed business/functional/technical requirements and specifications for the application and configuration of the end user applications and/or system
Coding internally developed applications and/or configuring commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) applications using programming, scripting, and database languages.
Supporting application testing, deployment, maintenance, and evolution activities by correcting programming errors, responding to scope changes, and coding application enhancements.
Ensure Technical Excellence: Oversee code quality through reviews, testing, and performance monitoring.
Prioritization & Backlog: Manage the product backlog and prioritize features based on user needs and strategic direction.
Implement Scalable Solutions: Ensure the tool is scalable, adaptable, and meets evolving company requirements.
User-Centric Design: Incorporate user feedback to enhance usability and functionality.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Facilitate communication between users and developers, ensuring alignment and transparency.
Support & Documentation: Provide last-level support, maintain documentation, and deliver training and release notes

Your background

Proven ability to engage and manage diverse stakeholders effectively.
Capable of managing resources and assessing risks in complex projects.
Familiarity with engineering and software development processes.
Strong problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
Strong C# Development Skills: Proficient in C# with experience in building robust applications.
Advanced proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL)
Architectural & QA Knowledge: Solid understanding of software architecture, code review, and quality assurance practices.
Familiar with secure coding standards and industry best practices.
Effective in task prioritization, user collaboration, training, and documentation.
Ability to lead tool development teams and provide technical guidance.
Strategic & Continuous Improvement Mindset: Skilled in strategic thinking and committed to ongoing improvement.

More About Us

A holistic range of competitive benefit program to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us – in work and out.

For this role, depending on grade and experience we offer the following employee benefits (subject to the respective plan rules): Annual Incentive Plan, Flexible Working, Meal Allowance, Life Insurance, Medical Check-up, Psychological assistance, Language trainings, Coaching & Assessments.

jobs.title: Software Developer (m/f/d)
jobs.location: Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain
jobs.description:
We are TecAlliance — founded by more than 30 automotive aftermarket companies as a neutral Data‑as‑a‑Service market connector, serving as the neutral data terrain that interconnects them. With over 1,000 employees worldwide and customers in 140 countries, we enable the market — we never compete with it.

Join us in our Tenerife office as a Software Developer (m/f/d) to create and enhance technology solutions that support the company’s strategic goals and evolving business needs. Through the delivery of effective and sustainable software products, you will directly contribute to improving user experience, increasing productivity, and enabling business growth.

This is a full time position with 40 hours of work per week. You'll be working at our Santa Cruz de Tenerife office at least 1-2 days per week, while working the other days remotely, in agreement with your team.

Main Tasks

Develop and maintain software solutions and components.
Analyze business and technical requirements.
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
Test and debug software solutions.
Resolve software defects and technical issues.
Participate in code reviews and team collaboration.
Support system performance and reliability improvements.
Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation initiatives.

Requirements

Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent vocational training or practical experience.
Experience in software development within Agile environments.
Experience designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software solutions and components.
Exposure to working with modern development tools, version control systems, and software design principles.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional and international teams.
Experience solving technical challenges and delivering scalable, reliable software products.
Fluent English language skills (B2 level or higher) are mandatory, Spanish language would be a plus.

Technical Skills

About 5 years of hands-on software development and coding experience.
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with AWS, including developing, deploying, and/or operating cloud-based applications and services.
Strong proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages/frameworks: C#, Java, Go, Python, or Angular. Experience with additional languages or frameworks is an advantage but can be developed on the job.
Strong knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
Solid understanding of software development principles, methodologies, and best practices.
Good understanding of software design, architecture, and design patterns.
Experience with version control systems, particularly Git.
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Practical experience working in Agile development environments.
Knowledge of software testing, automated testing, and code quality practices.
Experience applying good engineering practices to build maintainable, scalable, and reliable software solutions.

We kindly ask you to apply with an English CV only. Thank you.

Benefits

Contracts, Salary, and non-monetary benefits

💪 All our contracts are by default unlimited (probation period is six months).

💪 Compensation package: 97% fixed base salary paid monthly, with a 3% performance-based bonus paid annually, dependent on company performance.

🌏 Our travel policy allows for expense reimbursement, ensuring you can explore the world without stressing over your wallet.

🛡️ Group accident insurance.

🛒 Discounts on our corporate benefits program with a broad range of partners.

💸 Flexible remuneration: You have the option to allocate a portion of your salary towards either discounted meal vouchers, kindergarden or health insurance, providing you with valuable benefits and tax advantages.

Location-independency / flexibility:

💯 Hybrid: you'll join us at our Santa Cruz de Tenerife office at least 1-2 days per week, while working the other days remotely, in agreement with your team.

🚀 Structured Onboarding: you receive an individual onboarding plan, have multiple onboarding days in the beginning, and a wealth of e-learning, training, and documentation besides your team at your disposal.

👩‍💻 Set-up: for this, we will provide you with a tailored tech set-up (notebook, headset, backpack) if you are working in an office, and for remote workers we have an extended set-up.

🏖 Vacation: 30 days a year.

⚖️ Balance job & life: Flexible working hours: you decide where and when you work.

Culture

🧬 We value ownership, cooperation, entrepreneurial thinking & and self-reflection to communicate effectively as ONE team.

🎟️ Team culture is Key! We have fun at work and beyond: There is always something to celebrate and regular team events.

🦄 Come as you are - do you prefer T-shirts over a shirt? Great.

💡 Your contribution matters: shape our value-driven culture and agile transformation together with your colleagues – we’re curious, want to go one step further, build further trust together, and join forces to tackle our challenges as a team.

jobs.title: Advanced Solution Engineer/ (C#, .net, Exp in Fintech Payment gateways, Microservices, MQs, Cache)
jobs.description:
Apply directly at https://seersolutions.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/4438
Company Description

Seer Solutions provides advanced and comprehensive digital solutions for financial institutions, enabling them to offer their products in a fast, easy, convenient, and cost-effective manner. By digitalizing processes, Seer Solutions helps financial partners adapt to the rapidly changing industry landscape. With strong research and development capabilities, the company ensures that its partners remain competitive. Seer Solution's dedicated team is committed to exceeding the expectations of its financial institution partners.
Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for an Advanced Solution Engineer position with the below requirement and qualification. The position is based in Dubai, JLT.

Role and Responsibilities
Strong C#, ASP.NET Core (.NET 6/7/8), Web API
Hands-on microservices development using REST/gRPC and API Gateway patterns.
Strong SQL Server skills (stored procedures, query tuning, indexing, and troubleshooting).
Experience with EF Core, clean/layered architecture, and design patterns.
Practical experience with RabbitMQ/MassTransit or similar message-based integration.
Redis/distributed caching, Docker and Linux basics.
Secure API development: JWT/OAuth2, encryption basics.
FinTech, digital wallet, payment, remittance or banking domain experience.

Nice to have

Observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger/Open Telemetry.
CI/CD experience using Azure DevOps
Kubernetes, Azure cloud

Qualifications and Education Requirements

1. Minimum bachelor’s in computer science or information technology
8 -10 years of professional software development experience.
FinTech, digital wallet, payment, remittance or banking domain experience.
Experience leading small technical streams or acting as a senior contributor to a team.
Experience in database design/review, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.

Apply directly at https://seersolutions.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/4438
